Here is the master plan for the **projects/circle‑menu.html** project. This plan follows the house‑planning‑doc standard and is kept scannable on a phone.

---

## (0) TURN/STAGE LEDGER
| Turn/Stage | Date | Status | What was built / Planned |
|------------|------|--------|---------------------------|
| 1          | 2024‑09‑01 | ✅ Done | Initial HTML skeleton, basic navigation, static mock‑up |
| 2          | 2024‑09‑08 | 🔄 In‑Progress | Add responsive CSS, interactive menu logic |
| 3          | 2024‑09‑15 | ⏳ Pending | Polish UI, add accessibility, write tests, release v1.0 |
| 4+         | – | 🟡 TBD | Future enhancements, bug fixes, etc. |

*Each future build session will add a new row here **before** touching any code.*

---

## (1) RELEASES
1. **v1.0 – Core Menu** – Provide a functional, mobile‑first circular navigation menu.  
2. **v1.1 – Enhanced UX** – Add swipe gestures, animations, and accessibility support.  
3. **v2.0 – Backend Integration** – Connect menu state to a simple data store/API.

---

## (2) Release‑by‑Release Details  

### Release v1.0 – Core Menu
**Scope (In / Out)**
- **In**: Static HTML structure, basic CSS for mobile view, JavaScript that toggles menu visibility, placeholder icons, basic semantic markup.
- **Out**: Swipe gestures, micro‑animations, accessibility ARIA attributes, external data handling.

**Build Gates (Verification on Real Devices)**
- Open the app in Chrome/Firefox on a phone; ensure layout fits ≤ 414 px width without horizontal scroll.  
- Tap the “Menu” button → menu expands/collapses correctly.  
- Tap a menu item → page navigates (or simulated navigation) without JavaScript errors.  
- Console free of errors (check via on‑screen log output).

**Backlog of Deferred Items**
- Swipe‑to‑open gesture (planned for v1.1)  
- CSS transitions & animations (v1.1)  
- ARIA labels & keyboard navigation (v1.1)  
- Persistent menu state across page loads (v2.0)

### Release v1.1 – Enhanced UX
**Scope (In / Out)**
- **In**: Swipe gestures, CSS animations, ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, optional theme toggle.
- **Out**: Persistent state via backend, advanced analytics, offline storage.

**Build Gates**
- Test swipe gesture on iOS/Android browsers; menu opens/closes fluidly.  
- Verify keyboard focus order with screen‑reader tools.  
- Visual regression check on 320‑px to 414‑px viewport sizes.  
- Console remains clean.

**Deferred Backlog**
- Persistent state via IndexedDB / API (v2.0)  
- Performance profiling & lazy loading (future)

### Release v2.0 – Backend Integration
**Scope (In / Out)**
- **In**: Sync menu selections to a simple REST endpoint, support offline fallback, add user analytics (basic count).
- **Out**: Advanced UI redesign, third‑party integrations, push notifications.

**Build Gates**
- Real device (phone) with network access can POST menu clicks to endpoint; response handled gracefully.  
- Offline scenario (airplane mode) stores actions locally and retries on reconnect.  
- No sensitive data exposed; all diagnostics logged in‑app.

**Deferred Backlog**
- Advanced theming & custom branding  
- Offline‑first service worker improvements  

---

## (3) FUTURE IDEAS (Parking Lot)
- Voice‑controlled menu activation  
- Drag‑and‑drop reorder of menu items  
- Integration with calendar/app schedule to surface relevant items  
- Progressive Web App (PWA) install prompt  
- A11y high‑contrast and scalable text options  
- Contextual help tooltips powered by a help‑system API  

*These are not scheduled yet; capture ideas here for later planning.*

---

## (4) IMMUTABLE WORKING RULES
- **Mobile‑first** – Start with the smallest breakpoint and progressively enhance.  
- **All diagnostics in‑app** – No console‑only debugging; log messages must appear on screen for user visibility.  
- **Update‑plan‑before‑code** – The plan is the sole authority; always edit the plan first, then implement.  
- **Read‑back verification** – After each push, the owner reads the updated plan back verbatim to confirm correctness.  
- **No stubs or fake data** – All UI states must reflect real data (or a minimal realistic placeholder) when displayed.  

---

## (5) DECISION LOG
| Date | Decision | Made By | Rationale / Notes |
|------|----------|---------|-------------------|
| 2024‑09‑01 | Use single‑file HTML app architecture | Owner | Keeps deployment simple, no build pipeline needed. |
| 2024‑09-03 | Target mobile‑first design with responsive CSS | Owner | Ensures best experience on phones; tablets get enhanced view. |
| 2024‑09-05 | Include basic accessibility (semantic tags) but defer ARIA until v1.1 | Owner | Prioritizes quick launch while planning a11y improvements. |
| 2024‑09‑07 | Choose a lightweight in‑app logging UI for diagnostics | Owner | Meets rule: all diagnostics visible to users, never just console. |
| 2024‑09‑09 | Store offline actions in IndexedDB for eventual sync | Owner | Satisfies v2.0 offline capability without heavy backend. |
| 2024‑09‑12 | Use a public mock JSON endpoint for demo data | Owner | Avoids needing a real backend during early testing. |

---

## (6) APPENDIX – Authority Order
1. **projects/circle-menu.md** – This document is the *sole* source of truth for goals, tasks, bugs, and any changes.  
2. **projects/circle-menu.html** – The live application code.  
3. **Chat history** – Subordinate; overrides only when the plan is explicitly updated.  

--- 

*All sections are marked TBD where the plan does not yet contain concrete details. The next turn will flesh out the missing stages and refine the backlog.*

messages.text: The starting point the orange heart with a smiling face that can be dragged and dropped anywhere on the screen it sits on top of all other apps, a single tap opens the ring, in the top right of a transparent box that contains the ring is an x to collapse it back tap and hold on the heart provides it or configuration menu option or a quit option. The ring should operate like a carousel a node can be dragged in clockwise or counterclockwise and it will rotate. The face if you drag across it right it rotates clockwise if you drag left it rotates counterclockwise if you drag down it begins to tilt the range of tilt goes from 0° to 10 to 25 to 45 to 65 to 85 to 90 you can drag up to reduce the tilt back to zero. Pinch zoom on the face will change the size slash circumference of the circle and therefore the spacing between the optionsAt the start the center is a gear we're settings modal opens to control things like color size sensitivity it also allows you to assign actions to tap and hold of the center and double tap. In the content configuration panel  is where the url fo icon and action are stored as a pair then saved as json in github . This allows nesting of menus so instead of calling an https with a HTML suffix you can call an https with a json suffiix as a sub menu. The number of nodes on the circle is dynamic based on the number of entries in the json. Once a sub menu has been called the center button of the circle now acts as a navigation button to go back up with a simple up arrow icon however a tap and hold will display the navigation chain as bread crumbs so for example if you went three levels deep you could jump up to the top level. The icons must be very polished and have a option in the configuration to have a simple SVG all the way to something that is 3D and has color for now the icon set should be pretty standard, forward back quit print share
